title: China Software Developer Network: 6.4M accounts breached
summary: In 2011, the China Software Developer Network (CSDN) suffered a data breach that exposed over 6M user records. The data included email addresses alongside usernames and plain text passwords.

title: ADDA: 1.8M accounts breached
summary: In March 2025, data allegedly breached from the ADDA housing societies service was posted to a public hacking forum. The data contained over 1.8M unique email addresses along with names, phone numbers and MD5 password hashes.

title: International Kiteboarding Organization: 340.3K accounts breached
summary: In November 2025, the International Kiteboarding Organization suffered a data breach that exposed 340k user records. The data was subsequently listed for sale on a hacking forum and included email addresses, names, usernames and in many cases, the user's city and country.
